title: Nice product overall
text: I was a little nervous given some of the reviews, but we received a large bag filled with several different types of chews that our dog loved. The packaging looked really nice (looks like they listened to reviews that were concerned with this!) and included a key chain light. We got several ears and both long and short jerky sticks; our dog loved the ears but chewed through the jerky in a minute. Overall, it was a great value for the promotional price, but at full price it doesn't keep our dog entertained long enough to be worth it for us.
label: positive
